title: Watchtower launch outline and quickchecks
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact watchtower-style launch outline for the upcoming service rollout window. Intended for on-call, release conductor, and cross-team leads. Not a full runbook — think quickchecks + cadence + release-note skeleton to carry into final notes.

Context / scope:
- Target: incremental rollout of 1.3.0 service mesh + routing fallback policy across hosted and dedicated pools.
- Goals: keep p50 latency within baseline, validate KV cache persistence, ensure model-fallback routing operates under synthetic throttle.
- Risk profile: medium (routing changes + config propagation). Primary risk: cascade fallback leading to capacity spike.

Preflight checklist (day -3 to day 0):
- Day -3: freeze infra changes (only critical hotfixes allowed). Owner: release-eng oncall.
- Day -2: smoke branch deployment to staging cluster; run latency/throughput smoke. Owners: platform-eng, sres.
  - Run synthetic load: 10k requests over 30m, mixture 70/30 chat/generation. Capture p50/p95/p99.
- Day -1: confirm observability hooks and dashboards are green (traces, tail-sampling, token-cost). Update watch queries if needed. Owner: observability.
- 12 hours before: announce timeline to #releases and #sre (UTC). Include rollback contact and pager list.
- 2 hours before: final checklist review in quick huddle (15m). Confirm shift handoffs and who will execute rollback.

Launch cadence (day 0):
- T-00:00 — deploy config-only to control plane (no routing changes yet). Confirm control plane health, leader election.
- T+00:10 — push routing policy to 5% of traffic via canary router. Monitor: latency, error-rate, token-cost spike.
- T+00:30 — if no regressions, expand to 25%. Otherwise: trigger throttle/rollback.
- T+01:30 — target 100% if stable for 45m at 25% and gradual scaling observed.
- T+02:00 — run full smoke suite (end-to-end, persistence, KV warms). Verify model fallback behavior with synthetic error injection.

Quickchecks (what to look for during rollout):
- Latency: p95 should not regress >15% from baseline. If yes, pause expansion.
- Error budget: API 5xx spike >0.4% sustained for 5m => rollback.
- Token cost variance: sudden +30% indicates unexpected model routing — investigate.
- KV cache hit rate: should stay within expected band: 78-96% depending on tenant mix. Drop below 65% -> suspect cache eviction or incorrect affinity.
- Autoscaler signals: check GPU utilization and queue length (infra team).
- Canary mismatch: if canary produces higher failure pattern than baseline, collect a sample trace and tag with canary-id.

Rollback decision ladder (fast):
- Level 1 (automated): immediate revert to previous routing config if 5xx > 1% for 3m or latency p99 > 2x baseline for 2m.
- Level 2 (manual): pause expansion if p95 > 15% for 10m or token-cost +50% for 10m. Confer with release lead.
- Level 3 (full rollback): roll back to previous release if degradation persists after Level 2 remediation (30m). Run postmortem checklist.

Communication plan (snippets to paste):
- Pre-launch (12h): "Heads-up: scheduled rollout of service 1.3.0 tomorrow 12:00 UTC. Watchtower cadence, canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Pager: @oncall-release. If you have runway constraints, please flag now."
- During anomaly: "Rolling back canary due to elevated 5xx (see ENG-2914). Rollback initiated at T+00:38. Monitoring for stabilization."
- Post-launch summary: short bullets for release notes (see skeleton below).

Release note skeleton (draft):
- Release: service 1.3.0 (rollout-id: watchtower-2027-04-03)
- Primary changes: routing policy for model fallback, control-plane config consolidation, observability tag additions.
- User impact: no expected interruption; improved fallback steadiness when primary models are throttled.
- Known issues: small chance of transient p95 latency increase during scale-up window. Observed in internal staging with noisy tenant mix; mitigations included staged expansion and short-term throttles.
- Rollout notes: gradual canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on key signals.

Telemetry & artifacts to collect (post-rollout):
- Canary-id traces (attach sample traces if rollback triggered).
- Token-cost distribution across models (before/after).
- Autoscaler scaling events and queue lengths.
- Post-rollout smoke results (compare to preflight).
- Annotated timeline of actions (who did what, timestamps).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether dedicated pools need separate config TTL (TODO: @Priya).
- Add a quick aggregated chart for token-cost by model to the release dashboard (TODO: observability).
- Finalize canary watch query set (we currently have 6; prefer 8 to reduce noise).

Field notes / heuristics from previous rollouts:
- When a canary shows minor p95 blips but stable p50, give it 30m for warm-up before deciding. Many regressions are cache-warm related.
- If token-cost jumps but latency stable, often this is due to model routing fallback (fallthrough to a bigger model). Check model routing table first.
- Keep some headroom on reserved GPU capacity during rollouts to avoid eviction storms on shared pools.

Short checklist for the release conductor (one-pager):
- Confirm owners present and Slack channels open.
- Run preflight smoke and attach screenshot.
- Deploy T0 control-plane config.
- Start canary at 5%, observe 30m, expand or pause.
- If any rollback, annotate timeline with precise timestamps and postmortem link.
- Publish final release note and close the epic (ENG-2914).

Appendix: quick commands
- Rollback routing (ops): gh pr comment --body "revert routing" https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1287
- Start canary (cli): rwdctl rollout start --policy watchtower-2027-04-03 --fraction 0.05
- Snapshot metrics: rwdctl snapshot metrics --from now-45m --to now --tags watchtower-2027-04-03 > /tmp/watchtower-snap.json

Slack channels & people to ping:
- #releases (announce), #sre (pager), #platform (infra), #observability (dash updates)
- Pager: @oncall-release, @oncall-sre

Endnotes:
This doc is intentionally compact — use it as the quick reference during the watch window. Move finalized notes into Confluence after the rollout and attach artifacts.
